title: SKS (Signature Kitchen Suite) — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for SKS (Signature Kitchen Suite).

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Swiss Perfection." Luxury tier. SKS (Signature Kitchen Suite) is LGs ultra-premium brand positioned against Sub-Zero/Wolf. Their defining feature is the 48-inch built-in French door refrigerator with InstaView. Only sold through authorized premium dealers — no big-box distribution. Made in South Korea with Swiss-inspired precision.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Ultra-luxury buyers in the LG ecosystem. Kitchen designers wanting an alternative to Sub-Zero.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for SKS (Signature Kitchen Suite):

• 48-inch built-in French door with InstaView — unique form factor

• Only through authorized premium dealers — true exclusivity

• LG technology with luxury positioning and build quality

• Sous vide built into the range — precision cooking standard

• Alternative to Sub-Zero/Wolf with better smart home integration
